Hello Carmen,

Sure, this unit is available, and we can arrange a viewing for you on Saturday.

Please note that the viewing will be self-viewing, and our available viewing hours are from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Kindly let us know your preferred time and share a copy of your ID, as we need to provide your details to the building team in advance for viewing access.

Thank you.
